thread:
cecilia: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the people changes. posting a short FAQ thread so managers and ICs have a place to ask.

omar: timeline Q 1: when do final team maps land?

cecilia: final maps by EOM, internal mobility opens the following Monday for three weeks.

viv: are there any immediate hiring pauses? curious about hiring for product roles.

ben: not a blanket pause. priority shift to infra/serving for next two quarters. product backfills approved case-by-case.

viv: what's the process for an urgent backfill?

ppl-ops-bot: urgent backfill path: manager -> director -> ppl-ops fast-track form (48h review goal). link will be in the guide.

omar: will there be templates for manager 1:1s?

cecilia: yes 1 manager script, transition checklist, and escalation contacts. HR running two live Q&A hours later this week.

ben: note for leads: oncall rotations may shift with team merges; we'll provide a 4-sprint handover plan.

viv: can folks apply to other teams during mobility window?

cecilia: yep, internal applicants get priority and a streamlined interview loop.

omar: thanks. pls keep updates in this thread so we can point folks here. :heart:

(From All-Hands 1 cecilia)
